title: Untangling Hate Speech Definitions: A Semantic Componential Analysis Across Cultures and Domains
reasoning: The paper includes 'Religion/Belief' as a primary demographic target in its Semantic Componential Analysis (SCA) framework and the resulting HateDefCon dataset. Furthermore, its cross-cultural benchmarking section evaluates LLMs specifically on their ability to detect hate speech based on legal definitions from countries (Syria, Jordan, Israel) where the protection of religious identity and the prevention of sectarian strife are central evaluative components.
